messages:
alex: Quick sync — EU aggregates are missing ~48h of events for some tenants. We need to pick reprocess windowing + routing policy for console rollout. Two options: aggressive 2h grace + single bulk replay or staggered rolling windows (6/12/24h). Also need rule whether replays go to Dedicated or Hosted pools. Thoughts? :thinking:
marta: Staggered. Bulk replays spike quota and mess with latency. 6h rolling windows give us smoother load and easier rollbacks.
jin: Agreed. Quick numbers: a 24h bulk for top 10 tenants ~= 120 GPU-hours, 6h windows ~= 30 GPU-hours but more orchestration.
priya: Console UX: we need per-tenant progress + ability to pause/resume specific tenant replays. Also a checkbox for "Use staggered windows" in the replay modal.
samir: Routing: committed tenants => Dedicated. Others => Hosted but with a soft throttle (10% of slot capacity) and fallback to queued mode. We should avoid bursting into shared pools.
alex: Can we implement throttling at routing layer (policy) + console flag? If yes, prefer staggered + Dedicated-first routing.
jin: I can add a policy rule in routing service. Proposed rule:
```
if tenant.commit >= commit_threshold:
  route -> dedicated_pool
else:
  route -> hosted_pool with quota=0.1*slot_capacity
```
marta: Also add a grace buffer for ingest lag: only start replay for hour h if h <= now - 3h to avoid reprocessing already-arrived late events.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: replay_job/2026-06-04-311 for tenants [alpha, beta, gamma], start=1766020000, windows=6h, routing=dedicated-first. (automated)
priya: For console, small UX ask: show ETA calc (tokens/GPUs) and expected cost estimate inline. Customers keep asking.
alex: Action items: jin add routing rule + feature flag, priya add console staggered checkbox + progress/ETA, samir add throttle enforcement, marta write short runbook for operator. We'll roll canary to 5 tenants first. :thumbsup: 
marta: I'll write runbook and link it here when done.
jin: I'll open PR for routing policy today.
alex: OK — consensus: staggered 6h windows, dedicated-first routing, hosted fallback with 10% throttle, console controls + pause. Rolling canary to 5 tenants. I'll follow up with a short RFC doc.
